title: Where a Snowsports School Household Was on the Mountain in Any Case
content:
Where the collective's own lift records show the household was on the mountain in any case, the day was not wholly lost to them and what is made good on a Snowsports School booking is reduced.

## The ladder

**First band.** Where the household holds a season pass standing in the active state and that pass account shows three or more lift scans in the month running to the handling date, the skied on offset of 45.00 USD is taken off.

**Second band.** Where the household holds a season pass standing in the active state and that pass account shows fewer than three lift scans in the month running to the handling date, the idle pass offset of 15.00 USD is taken off.

**Third band.** Where the household holds no season pass standing in the active state, no offset is taken off, the offset standing at 0.00 USD.

## Where the two facts are read

Both facts are read from the household's Season Pass Programme records: the state the pass stands in, and the lift scan entries standing on that pass account with a date inside the month running back from the handling date. Scans older than that month are not counted, and a pass standing in any state other than active puts the household in the third band whatever its scan entries show.

## The bands as a truth table

| Season pass standing in the active state | Lift scans in the month to the handling date | Offset taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 3 or more | 45.00 USD |
| yes | exactly 3 | 45.00 USD |
| yes | 2 | 15.00 USD |
| yes | none | 15.00 USD |
| no | any number | 0.00 USD |

## An illustration on a hypothetical combined figure

Take a combined figure of 200.00 USD standing to be made good on a Snowsports School booking. A household holding an active season pass with 6 lift scans in the month to the handling date has 45.00 USD taken off, leaving 155.00 USD. The same household with 2 scans has 15.00 USD taken off, leaving 185.00 USD. A household holding no active season pass has nothing taken off, and the figure stands at 200.00 USD.
